label: Standard delivery
description: Estimated 3–7 business days in transit after 1–3 business days of processing. Free for paid members or $250+ after discounts.

label: Express UPS
description: Not available until express dispatch and label service are confirmed.

label: UPS Next Day
description: Not available until next-day service and dispatch cutoffs are confirmed.

label: Priority Processing
description: Moves an eligible order ahead in the fulfillment queue. Availability requires supplier confirmation.

label: Cold Chain Shipping
description: Available only when temperature-controlled packaging and handling are confirmed.

label: Shipping Protection
description: Optional protection is not available until its coverage and claims terms are published.
